pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What can help you work out the meaning of an unknown word? (1 mark)
   A. The colour of the paper
   B. Nothing
   C. Clues in the words and pictures around it
   D. The size of the book

2. Which sentence means "There is a bed in the bedroom."? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室里有床。
   B. 门在左边。
   C. 沙发在哪儿?
   D. 客厅里有电视。

3. What does 清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. Church
   C. Week (short form)
   D. Today

4. Which sentence means "And you?"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 早上好!
   C. 你呢?
   D. 再见!

5. Which Chinese word means "spinach"? (1 mark)
   A. 米饭 mǐfàn
   B. 菠菜 bōcài
   C. 水果 shuǐguǒ
   D. 水 shuǐ

6. What does 卧室 (wòshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. In front of
   B. On
   C. Bedroom
   D. Chair

7. Which sentence means "Hello, teacher!"? (1 mark)
   A. 你呢?
   B. 我叫小明。
   C. 再见!
   D. 老师好!

8. Which word is pronounced fángjiān? (1 mark)
   A. 右边
   B. 放
   C. 房间
   D. 椅子

9. Which sentence is correct for "The chair is under the table"? (1 mark)
   A. 在椅子桌子下。
   B. 椅子下在桌子。
   C. 椅子在桌子下。
   D. 桌子在椅子下。

10. Which Chinese word means "drought"? (1 mark)
   A. 小 xiǎo
   B. 天 tiān
   C. 干旱 gānhàn
   D. 刮风 guā fēng

11. Which Kiswahili word is like Mandarin 妈妈 māma? (1 mark)
   A. dada
   B. kaka
   C. shule
   D. mama

12. What does 干旱 (gānhàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Also
   B. Drought
   C. It rains
   D. Weather

13. How is 冰箱 written in pinyin? (1 mark)
   A. bìngxiàng
   B. bīngxiāng
   C. bǐngxiāng
   D. bingxiang

14. On which vowel is the tone mark in zuǐba? (1 mark)
   A. u
   B. i
   C. a
   D. No vowel

15. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. 明天是星期一。
   B. 昨天是星期三。
   C. 今天是星期天。
   D. 今天是星期三。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: yǔ hěn dà. (2 marks)

17. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 下雨 and 耳朵. (2 marks)

18. Explain why tones are important in Mandarin. Give one example with meanings. (3 marks)

19. Rearrange and translate: 浴室 / 花园 / 旁边 / 在. (3 marks)

20. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There are five people in my family." (3 marks)

21. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天气 and 星期六. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Clues in the words and pictures around it
   Context gives clues.

2. A — 卧室里有床。
   卧室里有床。 (wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.) means "There is a bed in the bedroom.".

3. A — Mosque
   清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) means mosque.

4. C — 你呢?
   你呢? (nǐ ne?) means "And you?".

5. B — 菠菜 bōcài
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

6. C — Bedroom
   卧室 (wòshì) means bedroom.

7. D — 老师好!
   老师好! (lǎoshī hǎo!) means "Hello, teacher!".

8. C — 房间
   房间 is pronounced fángjiān and means room.

9. C — 椅子在桌子下。
   thing + 在 + place + 下.

10. C — 干旱 gānhàn
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

11. D — mama
   Mama means mother in both languages.

12. B — Drought
   干旱 (gānhàn) means drought.

13. B — bīngxiāng
   Both syllables have the first tone.

14. B — i
   In ui the second vowel takes the mark.

15. D — 今天是星期三。
   今天 is today.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: The rain is heavy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: 下雨: xià yǔ, it rains. 耳朵: ěrduo, ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: The tone changes the meaning of a word. For example mā means mother but mǎ means horse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying tone changes meaning, 2 marks for a correct pair with meanings.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 The bathroom is beside the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天气: tiānqì, weather. 星期六: xīngqīliù, Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
